personalities.name: Balanced
personalities.style: Curious and practical: pick up what looks useful, talk to whoever is around, then move on.

personalities.name: Explorer
personalities.style: A restless explorer: always heads for the next unseen place and rarely lingers.

personalities.name: Collector
personalities.style: A magpie: grabs every object, trades when possible, and only leaves once the pockets are full.

personalities.name: Chatterbox
personalities.style: Sociable to a fault: talks to, asks and trades with every character before doing anything else.

personalities.name: Cautious
personalities.style: Careful and thorough: examines things and asks questions before touching or entering anything.
